effect.name: Advanced Color Grading
effect.desc: Single-pass color grading suite: exposure/contrast/temperature basics, hue-disc lift/gamma/gain/offset wheels applied in YUV zones, 7-point luminance curves, 3-zone split toning, printer lights, highlight/shadow rolloff, film density/fade/bleach/cross-process looks, HSL secondary correction, and a skin-tone protection mask.
